items.title: For an unramified morphism, the relative inertia is the pullback of the inertia exactly when automorphism groups agree
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project — Morphisms of Algebraic Stacks

items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that for an unramified morphism of algebraic stacks, the relative inertia mapping isomorphically to the pullback of the inertia precisely when the morphism induces isomorphisms between the automorphism groups of points and their images (author lemma at source lines 10011-10023, label lemma-aut-iso-unramified). The proof (source lines 10025-10043) presents the source, identifies the comparison morphism with an etale morphism of group spaces, translates both conditions into statements about that morphism and concludes the nontrivial implication by the criterion that an etale universally injective morphism is an isomorphism (proof lines 10025-10042). The presentation of the comparison morphism and the fibre-by-fibre analysis are the substance. H3.
